name: io.github.mshtawythug/second-brain
title: Second Brain
description: Local-first personal knowledge base: hybrid pgvector + FTS and GraphRAG search, queryable via MCP

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL + pgvector connection string. Defaults to the local Docker instance (postgresql://brain:brain@localhost:55432/second_brain).

environmentVariables.name: BRAIN_EMBEDDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding backend: arctic (default, local Ollama), voyage (SaaS), qwen3 (local Ollama), or none (FTS-only, no embedder).

environmentVariables.name: BRAIN_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian-style vault the note / capture / daily tools write to.
